title: Notification settings
why: A settings form is where the native controls come back. A styled checkbox for the toggle, input[type=range] for the threshold, input[type=number] for the retention, an <hr> between the groups: each is one line, each looks approximately right, and none of them is themed, keyboard-labelled or RTL-correct. Switch, Slider, NumberInput, SegmentedControl and Divider exist so that line is never written.
